adr_to_acr.adr_title: IOSurface Single-Island Runtime with Tokio-Valkey Orchestration

extends.extension: Tokio PhaseScope governs MLX golden paths, Core ML blocking lanes, and Accelerate ring-buffer execution.
IOSurface Runtime Island is Apple Silicon v1 canonical memory truth for MLX, Core ML, and Accelerate.
Durable authority is the global finality layer for runtime receipts.
Receipt-before-ack is a board-wide invariant for recoverable work.
